item.text: I found the defect: the current code picks any unbound card with the same last four digits before checking bank identity, then removes that object and prepends the replacement. I’m changing selection to resolve bank identity from the shared bank catalog, legacy code/ID prefixes, and normalized bank-name aliases; the chosen donor will be replaced in place, with exact same-bank suffix matches taking priority.
